authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12459 śilā sense 1 gives Assamese xil stone/hailstone and Bengali sil flat grinding stone/hail. Eastern hil/sil stone is assigned to this family, with sibilant weakening to h explicitly retained as the regional sound qualification. This uses the eastern xil/sil comparanda, not Maldivian hila in the separate *śillā addendum. The general stone gloss and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain open. Exact response: hil.
